usageNotes: Use this to inspect a single firewall rule for a QEMU VM by its zero-based position index in the ruleset; call the rule-list endpoint first to discover valid positions. Requires VM.Audit on /vms/{vmid} — read-only, safe to call at any time regardless of VM power state. The pos path parameter is marked optional in the spec but must be supplied to target a specific rule.

examples.summary: Fetch rule at position 2 for VM 101 on node pve1

tips: Rule positions are zero-indexed and shift when rules above them are inserted or deleted — always re-query the list before referencing a position by number.
The 'enable' field in the response is an integer (1 = enabled, 0 = disabled), not a boolean.
If the VM uses firewall security groups, the 'action' field will contain the group name rather than ACCEPT/DROP/REJECT.
